message: 流星ネットワーク
The Demon we fought last night was on a whole different level compared to our past opponents.
We managed to drive it back, but... if that had happened in a residential area, we might have gotten the people of Ryuusei Town caught in the crossfire.
How am I supposed to fight from here on out? I don't know what I should prioritize in battle...

name: Synn
message: 「Helena-san?」
I run into Helena-san in a somewhat unexpected place.
She doesn't seem to have noticed me, and just as I'm about to go after her and say hello, I stop in my tracks and avert my eyes.
T-That's embarrassing. I shouldn't look! Helena-san walks into the public restroom.

name: Paqy
message: 「Hey, Helena just went into the utility closet, didn't she?」

name: Synn
message: 「Sh-She just mistook it for a stall door.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Like hell she did. Plus, she went in and hasn't come out, ya know?」
I wait for a while, but Helena-san doesn't show any sign of coming out.
Knowing it's rude, I walk up to the tall, narrow door of the utility closet.

name: Synn
message: 「There's no answer...」

name: Paqy
message: 「There ain't even a trace of anyone on the other side, ya know?」

name: Synn
message: 「Hey, didn't you just see things, Paqy?」

name: Paqy
message: 「I never lie to ya, Synn-sama, except when it comes to Ria-chan.」

name: Synn
message: 「Ahahaha, so you do lie when it's about Senpai.」
Letting out a deliberately dry laugh, I place my hand on the utility closet's doorknob.

name: Paqy
message: 「A-Are you serious!? No friggin' way!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Nobody's here...」

name: Synn
message: 「Uwaah!?」
Suddenly, the floor beneath my feet vanishes, and I go into free fall with Paqy still attached to me.

name: Synn
message: 「Uwah, wawah, uwaah!?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Wh-What the hell is goin' on!!」

name: Synn
message: 「I-I don't know. But it kinda feels like we're sliding down a steep slide.」

name: Synn
message: 「Guhaah!?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Kalpas!?」

name: Synn
message: 「...Ow... Where on earth are we...?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Hey, this is the Director's Office!」

name: Synn
message: 「So that was a secret passage, then.」
I look over the walls and ceiling again. Was it a bookshelf, a picture frame, a mirror... I can no longer tell where Paqy and I came out from. The passage is cleverly hidden.

name: Synn
message: 「Helena-san... isn't here either.」
I brought Paqy along and returned to Mihoshizaka Park. I opened the storage shed door just like before, though this time the floor didn't give way.

name: Synn
message: 「Did this passage get sealed off because I found out about it?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Why would it be for a reason like that? It ain't an emergency, so of course it won't work.」
It finally dawns on me. Helena-san showed it to me on purpose.
In all likelihood, these passages stretch all across Ryuusei Town, so they can be used as evacuation routes in case of an emergency.

name: Synn
message: 「Helena-san...」
As commander of the Crusaders, she will dedicate herself to a support role. Therefore, you all must focus on growing stronger.
That's what it means.

name: Synn
message: 「Alright, I'm gonna train hard!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Hey, Synn-sama, hate to throw cold water on all that thoughtfulness and fired-up spirit of yours, but...」

name: Paqy
message: 「From sliding down that secret passage, the seat of your pants is all shiny and scuffed, you know?」
For the time being, I headed back home to change my pants.
